args.summary: checkout-api failed health checks following the v2.3.1 production deployment (v2.3.1 was unhealthy in all production regions; the v2.3.1-rc release candidate had also been unhealthy in staging). Rollback executed to the most recent release that was healthy in production, v2.3.0, across all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rollback completed and confirmed healthy: all regions now running v2.3.0 with an error rate of 0.2%. No change-manager approval was required since v2.3.0 was previously healthy in production. v2.3.1 should be investigated and fixed before any redeploy attempt.
args.title: checkout-api health check failures after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
All done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Investigated**: Pulled checkout-api's deployment history and identified **v2.3.1** as the failing latest deploy and **v2.3.0** as the most recent release that was healthy in production.

2. **Rolled back**: Executed a rollback to v2.3.0 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). No change-manager approval was needed since v2.3.0 was previously healthy in production.

3. **Verified recovery**: Confirmed checkout-api is now healthy across all regions on v2.3.0 with a 0.2% error rate.

4. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** (on-call paged) documenting the health check failures, the rollback, and the current healthy state, flagging v2.3.1 for investigation before any redeploy.
